title: Says Who?
headline: SAYS WHO?
synopsis: Glitch stamps '96 tests, all passing!' on a PR; Kit asks for proof and now the digest keeps the run that shows it.
altText: A three-panel Sunday strip. Panel 1: Glitch the beetle proudly stamps 'ALL TESTS PASS!' on a PR page while Kit the fox raises an eyebrow. Panel 2: Kit pulls a receipt from a filing cabinet labeled RUNS showing '109 pass, 0 fail'. Panel 3: Glitch, surprised, holds the receipt; Kit grins.

panels.scene: Glitch the beetle proudly slams a big rubber stamp onto a pull request page; Kit the fox watches, one eyebrow raised
Kit pulls a long receipt out of a filing cabinet drawer labeled RUNS
Glitch holds the receipt, surprised; Kit grins and points at it
